access.payment: public free GET API documented by Alternative.me

smoke_evidence.response_shape: seven newest-first daily observations, each value in 0..100 with a Unix timestamp and classification; newest observation was fresh at retrieval
smoke_evidence.access_qualification: Official docs describe this free public GET endpoint without credentials and require attribution; one anonymous request returned the documented envelope and data shape without payment or credential challenge.
smoke_evidence.scope: This verifies only the F&G endpoint and limit=7 response at this observation time.

access.policy: Only GET /fng/ with format=json and limit 1..31 is exposed. Never use unrelated price API routes or attach credentials.

routing.task: daily broad crypto market sentiment context
required_identity: Alternative.me Fear and Greed Index; broad BTC/large-crypto market context
routing.caveat: This is a composite context series and not asset-specific evidence, primary-event verification, or independent confirmation of data inputs that may contribute to the index.

request_policy.official_update_note: API documentation says unnecessary requests should be avoided because endpoints update every 5 minutes; the F&G index itself is described as daily.
request_policy.retry_policy: No automatic retries. On 401, 403, 402, 404, 429, timeout, malformed data, or network error, stop and report the classified status.
request_policy.fallback_policy: No fallback is qualified; report unavailable rather than substituting a different sentiment measure.

normalization.timestamps: Convert each provider Unix timestamp to UTC RFC3339 and retain the original integer. Retrieval time is separately recorded. Mark newest item stale after 48 hours; historical rows are intentionally older and must not be treated as current.
normalization.units: Integer index points from 0 through 100; preserve provider classification string.
normalization.identity: The index describes broad Bitcoin/large-crypto market sentiment, not sentiment for an arbitrary token.

upstream.lineage: Alternative.me composite index derived from multiple sentiment inputs; component methodology is described on its index page.
upstream.independence_status: Composite context only; not independent corroboration of its component inputs or market claims.
upstream.rule: Do not treat another wrapper over Alternative.me as independent.

missingness: Missing records and metadata errors remain missing or unavailable. Duplicate, unordered, invalid, future, or stale timestamps are flagged; never fill missing index values with zero.
